business_overview.one_sentence: Ajisen (China) operates fast casual Japanese ramen restaurants mainly in Mainland China and Hong Kong, supported by central kitchens and a small noodle-product manufacturing business.

segments.name: Operation of restaurants
segments.business_substance: Mainland China and Hong Kong Ajisen restaurant operation

segments.name: Manufacture and sales of noodles and related products
segments.business_substance: Noodle and related product manufacturing and sales

segments.name: Investment holding
segments.business_substance: Investment properties, unlisted equity instruments, fund investments, associates and joint venture

business_overview.revenue_model: Restaurant sales are recognised when customers purchase food, mostly immediate payment; noodle product revenue is recognised when goods are delivered.
business_notes: As at 31 December 2025 the group had 617 restaurants, including 577 in Mainland China, 39 in Hong Kong and one in Europe.
The network is supported by central kitchens in Shanghai, Chengdu, Tianjin, Wuhan, Dongguan and Hong Kong.
